objective: Locate the first order-dependent tensor between layer-0's invariant request-isolated GDN projection and layer-1's order-dependent post-core normalized rows.

treatment.trace_method: Opaque identity custom op reads live pure-prefill request boundaries and appends exact per-request SHA-256 digests; returned tensor aliases no input and is numerically identical.

mandatory_gates.semantic_source: Require trace calls in Qwen3NextDecoderLayer.forward and one custom-op registration.
mandatory_gates.runtime: Require both TP ranks, layers 0 and 1, both packed orders, and all expected tensor stages before interpreting outputs.
mandatory_gates.identity: Trace op declares the observed tensor as a sequencing dependency, returns no model value, and must not modify it; c1 must remain exact.

workload.warmup: One c1 and two c2 repeats.
workload.qualification: One c1 and ten c2 repeats are sufficient for boundary localization if both packed orders appear.

decision.first_varying_stage: The next repair targets only that operation and must preserve the exact c1 arm.
decision.no_stage_varies: Extend to the next full-attention or residual consumer; do not infer from token outputs alone.
decision.trace_gate_fails: Invalidate without tensor or token interpretation.

resource_boundary: Use 12 GiB container RAM and 16 GiB RAM-plus-swap; no reboot or GPU reset.
reporting_boundary: Observation-only diagnostic. No public speed, README headline, website, or LocalMaxxing update.
